scope: development-only R-peak benchmark candidate; not linked into the iOS App
reviewNotes: A dependency package's own Package.resolved is ignored by SwiftPM consumers, so this top-level package constrains Surge exactly.
PeakSwift imports HealthKit in its main target and includes C, C++ and Objective-C++ targets; an Apple-platform build is required.
The upstream wavelib submodule uses an SSH URL. The repository test script applies a process-local Git HTTPS rewrite without changing global Git configuration.
PeakSwift exposes eleven enum cases although its README advertises nine detectors. The benchmark CLI exposes only the nine named public detector algorithms.
No candidate is selected for production and no accuracy claim is made by this audit.
